set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM. P1 bounded repair, discovered while unblocking native route audit bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3. Consumer provenance: PLS Neuro standard-template ticket bd-01M2421N7AZQX1AK5BEMVSB84K (foreign store; not a dependency edge).

Observed defect
At exact PR #8 head206243b37adff1ab3dc67f7ee4dda44a9d42e547, the full repository JVM/Scala.js CI run36000441644 fails on Eclipse Adoptium Java17.0.20.1. surfaceJVM/Test compilation fails at modules/surface/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface/reference/FslrQualification.scala:338:
  val id = Thread.currentThread().threadId()
  value threadId is not a member of Thread
This is an actual hosted compile failure, not a timeout or a failed numerical mapping assertion. Focused gates passing do not cover this failing test source.
Evidence: https://github.com/canardlapin/scalafim/actions/runs/36000441644/job/107635499178 ; fetched raw log /private/tmp/e18-scalafim-pr8-failed-ci-20261001.log. API/CI state checked2026-10-01; no local reproduction or fix claimed by this filing.

Bounded scope
Repair the allocation-measurement probe so it compiles on the supported CI JDKs, retaining the actual current-thread allocation measurement. Use the native provider's isolated worktree and exact path reservations, coordinating with the current-main reconciliation of the route. Do not silently remove the probe from the aggregate, raise the minimum JDK, suppress errors globally, change scientific sampling, or relax numerical/coverage budgets.

Reproducer and acceptance
- Fresh exact candidate with JDK17: sbt "surfaceJVM/Test/compile" (then relevant qualification/test entry points with declared fixtures).
- Supported newer JDK compile/check must remain warning-clean; keep compatibility explicit rather than trading the Java17 error for an unhandled newer-JDK deprecation.
- Re-run affected surface JVM/JS gates and required full repository compile/test lanes in bounded batches; retain exact source/provider closure, commands and exit status. Aggregate hosted gate must pass on the revised exact PR candidate before calling it merge-ready.
- Check that allocation measurement still returns meaningful evidence when supported and records an explicit limitation when unavailable; no fabricated zero-memory claim.

Handoff: exact commit, changed paths, supported JDK identities, raw logs/receipts, remaining native/scientific limits. This repair alone does not qualify the fsLR coordinate route or grant PLS Neuro admission.
set.title: Restore Java 17 compatibility of fsLR qualification allocation probe (PR 8 full CI)
